name: novorossiysk-news-monitoring
description: Private news monitoring system for Novorossiysk — ingestion, event grouping, AI editorial drafts, moderation and Telegram publishing.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @nnm/shared && npm run build -w @nnm/backend && npm run build -w @nnm/frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @nnm/backend" "npm run dev:worker -w @nnm/backend" "npm run dev -w @nnm/frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nnm/shared && npm run test -w @nnm/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nnm/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nnm/backend && npm run typecheck -w @nnm/frontend
